title: echinochloa crus-galli var. oryzicola
intro: Echinochloa crus-galli var. oryzicola, commonly known as barnyard millet, is a type of wild grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of barnyard millet include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce triglycerides, and improve insulin sensitivity. The bioactive constituents present in barnyard millet include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
